subject.title: Context pruning mode 'off' not preventing compactions (Anthropic API key, cache-ttl smart defaults)

question: Should OpenClaw add supported hard-limit-only or fully-off automatic compaction semantics, and should persisted compaction entries record a closed trigger reason?
rationale: Current source supports disabling pruning but not automatic compaction, and changing compaction safety behavior or transcript metadata is a compatibility-sensitive product choice.

options.title: Define hard-limit semantics
options.body: Add a supported mode or option that disables threshold/safeguard compaction while preserving overflow recovery, with docs, tests, and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Keep safeguard policy
options.body: Decline a disable mode and narrow this issue to verifiable false-trigger fixes plus clearer documentation.

options.title: Defer to live repros
options.body: Wait for current-main Anthropic proof and track subagent wake-up work in the related narrower issue.

recommendation.title: Define hard-limit semantics
recommendation.body: Add a supported mode or option that disables threshold/safeguard compaction while preserving overflow recovery, with docs, tests, and upgrade behavior.
